description: This source file defines the TokenRefreshAuthenticator class, which implements an HTTP authentication mechanism that automatically attempts to refresh expired tokens upon receiving a 401 Unauthorized response. It prevents infinite retry loops and ensures only one refresh occurs concurrently.

classes.name: TokenRefreshAuthenticator
classes.description: An OkHttp Authenticator that handles automatic token refresh on 401 responses, with safeguards against infinite loops and concurrent refreshes.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles the authentication process by refreshing the token when needed, excluding certain endpoints and preventing infinite loops.

methods.name: responseCount
methods.description: Counts the number of responses in the response chain to prevent infinite retry loops.
